_meta.title: Massacres, pogroms, ethnic cleansing and religious persecution, worldwide (Wikidata)
_meta.what: Every Wikidata item that is a pogrom, an act of ethnic cleansing or religious persecution (or a direct subclass); every massacre, mass murder, murder or terrorist attack that Wikidata files as part of a genocide, ethnic cleansing, pogrom or persecution; and every such killing whose recorded victims are an ethnic or religious group, or whose recorded cause is racism, antisemitism, Islamophobia or another hatred of a group. Items already on the map's other Wikidata layers (attacks, Holocaust massacres, genocides, caste violence) are left out. What is filed under what is Wikidata editors' classification, not a court's, and some conflicts are recorded in far more detail than others.
